events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: English singer and songwriter Liam Gallagher was born on September 21, 1972, in Manchester.

angles.name: Liam's Legacy
angles.copy: The iconic voice of Oasis, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday today. What's your favourite track he's fronted?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's second solo studio album, 'Imagine,' was released on September 9, 1971, in the US and October 8, 1971, in the UK.

angles.name: Imagine Impact
angles.copy: John Lennon's seminal album 'Imagine' dropped 55 years ago today. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as powerfully now.

events.title: The original iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first iPod on October 23, 2001, and it became available for purchase on November 10, 2001.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Tunes
angles.copy: Remember when you could fit 1,000 songs in your pocket? The original iPod was unveiled 25 years ago today, changing how we listened to music forever.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the anniversary of the 1962 premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No'.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred, naturally) to 007 and his incredible six-decade cinematic legacy. What's your favourite Bond film or theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Winston Lennon was born on October 9, 1940, in Liverpool, England.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon, who would have turned 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations worldwide.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, and screenwriter John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939, in Weston-super-Mare, Somerset.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is truly timeless.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Wonder
angles.copy: An absolute masterpiece turns 58 today! The Beatles' iconic 'White Album' pushed boundaries and delivered a staggering collection of tracks.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, lead vocalist of Queen, died on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45, from complications of AIDS.

angles.name: Forever A Champion
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the unparalleled talent and showmanship of Freddie Mercury, who left us 35 years ago. His legacy continues to rock the world.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Revolution
angles.copy: A pivotal moment in music history: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' album was released 61 years ago today, showcasing their evolving sound and songwriting brilliance.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: John Lennon was fatally shot on December 8, 1980, outside his residence in New York City.

angles.name: Lennon's Lasting Peace
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who tragically passed away 46 years ago today. His powerful voice for peace and his timeless music live on.
